title: Classification of Strongly Rational Vertex Operator Algebras with Central and Effective Central Charge One
summary: We classify the strongly rational vertex operator algebras whose central charge and effective central charge are both one. Every such algebra is isomorphic to one of $V_L,V_L^+,V_{A_1}^{A_4},V_{A_1}^{S_4},V_{A_1}^{A_5},$ where $L$ ranges over the positive-definite even lattices of rank one and $A_1=\sqrt2\mathbb{Z}$.
